analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services reported strong financial growth for FY26, with total income rising 75.05% and EBITDA expanding significantly. The company is focused on expanding its owned fleet to improve operational control and revenue visibility, having recently inducted the vessel Artemis. Management remains optimistic about long-term opportunities in the Indian maritime sector, supported by government initiatives and favorable demand-supply dynamics. The company plans to continue its strategy of disciplined fleet expansion and prudent capital allocation to drive sustainable growth. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr, EBITDA of ₹152.55 Cr, and Net Profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover for FY27, assuming all vessels are operational in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to remain in the 45% to 50% band.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market are improving utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent approximately $15 million for the acquisition of two new vessels, Hades and an MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects the tax rate for FY27 to be in the range of 1.5% to 2%.
margins_costs.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

margins_costs.claim: The company targets an average of 330 operational days per year for its vessels to account for maintenance.
margins_costs.quote: A ballpark figure is that the vessel doesn't operate 360. An optimum would be about 330.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management drove growth in revenue and profitability in H2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Owned-vessel operations enhance the company's margin profile.
margins_costs.quote: Enhances margin profile through owned-vessel operations

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns 12 vessels in total.
Five of the eight owned vessels are currently on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to continue its expansion strategy by adding seven to eight vessels over the next two to three years.
capital_allocation.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces potential risks from monsoon seasons which halt offshore work.
risks_headwinds.quote: As far as the other EPC contracts are coming up, they are, like I said, it is a seasonal thing. During the monsoon, they cannot work.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted that vessel acquisition costs are impacted by currency exchange rate fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96.

risks_headwinds.claim: Key business risks include economic performance in Indian and international markets, competition, execution of company strategy, and market preference shifts.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to add seven to eight vessels over the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated its commitment to building a robust asset base to support sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
